name: MitID
description: MitID's own colours in light and dark (its blue, white, navy and greys), small corners, a plain header and outlined cards; PIN entry as masked progress dots (how many digits, never which); every MitID screen marked secure, so no view can hide anything there; the approve slider as a slide you drag, in MitID's own word, which Relaid then swipes (the touch permission: MitID 3.8 takes no click there).
